reconstructed_theorem_text: For functions w,b:[0,infinity)->R and T>0, suppose w is continuous on [0,T] and b is integrable for lambda_T, the pullback to NNReal of real Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T]. Set P_b(T,t)=integral_{[0,T]} 1_{s<min(t,T)} b(s) ds and t_i^n=i*T/2^n for i=0,...,2^n. Then, as n tends to infinity through natural numbers, sum_{i=0}^{2^n-1} w(t_i^n)*(P_b(T,t_{i+1}^n)-P_b(T,t_i^n)) converges in R to integral_{[0,T]} w(t)*b(t) dt. The prefix definition uses the strict inequality s<min(t,T).
objects: Real functions w,b on NNReal; horizon T; transported Lebesgue measure lambda_T; clipped prefix integral P_b; dyadic grid.
domains: Time NNReal; T strictly positive; all sums and integrals real-valued.
quantifiers: For every w,b,T satisfying the hypotheses, the displayed natural-number sequence converges to the stated integral.
assumptions: T>0; w continuous on [0,T]; b integrable with respect to lambda_T.
conclusion: Deterministic convergence of the weighted prefix-increment sums to integral w*b.
scopes: Grid covers [0,T], weights at left endpoints, n->infinity; ordinary real convergence.
constant_dependencies: No constants or rate are asserted; T,w,b determine every term and the limit.
